hook: The kanji 人 looks like a person walking on two legs.
One single line (一) means one.
何 was first drawn as a person (亻) carrying a load: "What is that?" (なに).
A tree (木) with a mark at its base: the root or origin, and also a book.
少 means few or little: just a little scoop (すこ) of rice.
A line going through the middle of a box: 中 is the inside or middle.
手 looks like a hand with fingers spread; "te" like the start of "ten fingers".
Words (言) from the tongue (舌): talking, telling a story.
Time (時) + interval (間): a span of time.
Meet (会) + company (社): a place where people meet to work, a company.
A roof (宀) over a pig (豕): in old China the home kept pigs under the roof.
前 means front or before: "Ma, eh? Look in front!"
Born (生) before (先) you: the person who knows more, your teacher.
Serve (仕) + matter (事): the things you do to serve, your job.
今 means now: "I'm a" student now (いま).
私 means private, myself: I keep my own rice plant (禾) private.
Same kanji 私 (private, I), but the longer reading わたくし is the extra polite "I".
Section (部) + roof or house (屋): a section of the house, a room.
Electric (電) + vehicle (車): an electric train.
年 means year; the years you have lived are your age (とし).
Now (今) + day (日): the day that is now, today (special reading きょう).
A building (广) where goods are shown: 店 is a shop; "me, see" the shop (みせ).
Stand (立) by a tree (木) and cut it with an axe (斤): fresh, new wood.
A woman (女) with her child (子): the love she feels, liking.
上 is a line pointing up from the ground: above, on top.
Bright (明) + day (日): the next bright day, tomorrow (special reading あした).
十 is a cross, like the Roman X for ten.
Ten (十) when counting things: ひとつ, ふたつ, up to とお, the only one with no つ.
Electric (電) + talk (話): talking by electricity, the telephone.
Two lines (二) for two; you have two knees (に).
Self (自) + part (分): your own part, oneself.
後 means behind or after: what comes after, later.
Materials (料) + logic (理): putting ingredients together with skill, cooking.
先 means ahead: the place ahead of you, or the time before.
車 looks like a cart from above, a wheel on an axle: it comes (くる) rolling.
Copy (写) + truth (真): a true copy of what you see, a photo.
One (一) + person (人): one person, alone (special reading ひとり).
Every (毎) + day (日): every day.
行 was drawn as a crossroads: you go out onto the road.
父 shows hands holding a tool: the hard working father.
A person (亻) resting by a tree (木): rest, a day off.
Hand (手) + paper (紙): paper you write by hand, a letter.
The sun rising in the grass while the moon (月) is still out: morning.
Under a roof (亠), a person (亻) and the evening moon (夕): night.
Study (学) + life (生): a person whose life is study, a student.
Effort (勉) + strong (強): working hard and strong, studying.
母 is a woman with two dots for breasts: mother. "Ha ha," laughs mum.
One (一) + number or turn (番): number one, the best.
House (家) + tribe (族): the group in one house, your family.
女 looks like a woman kneeling with crossed arms: woman.
Three lines (三) for three; "sun" sounds like さん.
金 means gold or money; お makes it polite: money.
An ox (牛) on the left: an ox was a valuable thing, an object.
The horse (馬) on the left: stations were where travellers changed horses.
Study (学) + school (校): a place for study, a school.
One (一) thing: ひとつ, counting objects with つ.
Two (二) + person (人): two people (special reading ふたり).
雨 shows drops falling from a cloud: rain. "Ah, meh," rain again.
Say (言) + leaf (葉): words fall from your mouth like leaves.
山 looks like three mountain peaks.
Name (名) + before (前): the name you say before anything else.
大 is a person with arms stretched wide: big.
小 is a thing split into tiny parts: small, little.
日 is the sun: one sun is one day, so 日 counts days and dates.
同 means same: one mouth (口) under one cover, all saying the same thing.
Ten (十) + mouth (口): a story passed through ten mouths is old.
木 looks like a tree with branches and roots.
Big (大) + study (学): big study, a university.
近 has the road part (辶): only a short road to go, nearby.
Big (大) + cut (切): something that cuts deep into your heart is important.
Sun (日) + weekday (曜日): the sun's day, Sunday.
Previous (昨) + day (日): the day before, yesterday (special reading きのう).
Every (毎) + morning (朝): every morning.
Question (問) + topic (題): a question topic, a problem.
大 is a person with arms stretched wide to show something big.
Origin (本) + hit (当): it hits the true origin, real.
方 means direction or way: a polite way to point to a person, or a way of doing.
The thread (糸) part: paper was made from fibres.
One (一) + cord (緒): tied by one cord, together.
Blue (青) + fight (争): the fight turns calm and blue, quiet.
Whole (全) + part (部): all the parts, everything.
Rice field (田) + street (丁): fields with streets become a town.
Upper (上) + hand (手): having the upper hand, skillful.
目 is an eye turned on its side; "me" sees with my eyes.
Journey (旅) + go (行): going on a journey, a trip.
Clothing (衤) + knife (刀): cutting the cloth is the first step, the first time.
Refine (練) + learn (習): learning by doing it again and again, practice.
下 is a line pointing down from a bar: below, under.
来 means come: "Come!" sounds a bit like くる.
New (新) + hear (聞): new things you hear about, the newspaper.
Head (首) + road (辶): the road your head leads you along, the way.
Door (戸) + axe (斤): the place where you keep your tools, a place.
人 (person) read じん after a country: 日本人 is a Japanese person.
人 (person) read にん when counting: 三人 is three people.
高 looks like a tall tower: tall, high, and a high price.
One (一) + day (日): one whole day, read いちにち.
One (一) + day (日), the first of the month: from つきたち, the moon (月) starts.
Origin (元) + spirit (気): your basic energy, healthy and lively.
言 is a mouth (口) with words coming out: to say.
Coming (来) + week (週): next week.
Field (田) + power (力): the one using power in the field, a man.
若 has grass (艹) on top: a fresh new sprout, young.
Head (頁) on the right: the front of your head, the face.
Two strokes (二 shape) + yawn (欠): yawning while you wait, you are next.
Reflect (映) + picture (画): pictures shown on a screen, a movie.
茶 has grass (艹) on top for tea leaves; "cha" like chai tea.
Self (自) + turn (転) + vehicle (車): a vehicle you turn yourself, a bicycle.
見 is an eye (目) on legs (儿): going to look, to see.
Evening (夕) + fortune telling (卜): fortunes were told at night, outside.
外 means outside: things outside this one are the others (ほか).
声 means voice: think of a choir voice singing "koe".
Tree (木) + measure (寸): a small place among the trees, a village.
小 shows a thing split into tiny bits: small.
Friend (友) + plural (達): your friends.
五 means five: "go" count to five on one hand.
Time (時) + measure (計): a thing that measures time, a clock.
多 is two evenings (夕夕) stacked up: many nights, many.
Sky (天) + air (気): what the air in the sky is like, the weather.
Idea (意) + taste (味): the taste of an idea, its meaning.
Sick (病) + institution (院): the place for sick people, a hospital.
Public (公) + garden (園): a public garden, a park.
Noon (午) + after (後): after noon, P.M.
Drawing (図) + writing (書) + building (館): a building for books, a library.
Mother (母) with polite お and さん: mum, said with respect.
窓 has a hole (穴) on top: a hole in the wall, a window.
Wealth (財) + cloth (布): a cloth holder for your money, a wallet.
Electric (電) + energy (気): electricity, and the electric light.
Sick (病) + spirit (気): a sick spirit, illness.
帰 means return: like a frog (カエル) going back to its pond, you go home (かえる).
寒 has a roof (宀) with ice (冫) at the bottom: cold even inside.
春 has the sun (日) at the bottom: the sun warms the plants in spring.
Tie (結) + marriage (婚): tying the knot, getting married.
寝 has a roof (宀) and a bed (丬) inside: lying down to sleep.
風 has an insect (虫) inside a frame: bugs blown by the wind.
An ear (耳) at the gate (門): listening at the gate, to hear.
Field (野) + greens (菜): greens from the field, vegetables.
Water (氵) + every (毎): water everywhere, the sea.
Han China (漢) + character (字): Chinese characters.
Teach (教) + room (室): a room for teaching, a classroom.
Earth (土) + weekday (曜日): 土星 is Saturn, so it is Saturday.
Words (言) + tongue (舌): using your tongue for words, to speak.
空 means sky or empty: a hole (穴) with nothing in it, the empty sky.
Medicine (医) + person (者): a person of medicine, a doctor.
Scatter (散) + walk (歩): walking around freely, a stroll.
Words (言) + bird (隹): you call out to the bird, "Who's there?"
Grass (艹) + change (化): a plant that changes into a flower.
水 looks like water splashing out from a central stream.
Moon (月) + weekday (曜日): the moon's day, Monday.
The sun (日) seen through a tree (木): the sun rises in the east.
Coming (来) + month (月): next month.
A border (囗) around a jewel (玉): a protected country.
白 is the sun (日) with a ray on top: bright white light.
出 means out, like 出口 (exit): you take things out or hand them in (だす).
長 was drawn as an old man with long hair: long.
Every (毎) + evening (晩): every night.
Child (子) + companion (供): children.
Person (亻) + move (動): a person moving about, to work.
Coming (来) + year (年): next year.
Second rate (亜) over a heart (心): a bad heart, bad.
Now (今) + year (年): this year (special reading ことし).
夏 means summer: the summer heat drives you "nuts" (なつ).
入 looks like a tent entrance: "Hi, I'm in!" (はいる), to enter.
Sun (日) + escape (免): when the sun escapes, it is evening.
Have (有) + name (名): to have a name, famous.
Person (亻) + origin (本): the base of a person, the body.
何 (what) + a counter: 何人 how many people, 何時 what time.
歌 has an open mouth (欠): opening your mouth wide to sing a song.
書 has a hand holding a brush (聿) at the top: to write.
Wind (風) + evil (邪): an evil wind gives you a cold; same sound as wind.
Two (二) things: ふたつ.
難 has a bird (隹): catching a bird is difficult.
本 is a tree (木) with a mark, so it counts long thin things like pens.
Gold or metal (金) + weekday: 金星 is Venus, so it is Friday.
暑 has the sun (日) on top: hot weather.
Gone (去) + year (年): the year that has gone, last year.
Lodging (宿) + topic (題): topics you take home, homework.
作 has a person (亻) on the left: a person making something.
A woman (女) under a roof (宀) is at peace (安): cheap prices give peace of mind.
弟 shows a rope wound in order: the brother who comes after you.
口 looks like an open mouth.
四 is a box (囗) with four sides; し also sounds like death, so people often say よん.
England (英) + language (語): the English language.
Give (授) + work (業): the work of giving lessons, a class.
Summer (夏) + rest (休み): summer vacation.
Load (荷) + thing (物): things you carry, luggage.
Silver (銀) + business (行): the business that holds your silver, a bank.
痛 has the sickness part (疒): when you are sick, it hurts. "Itai!"
弁当 is a boxed lunch, the "bento box"; お makes it polite.
